eyebrow: The automatic job isn't always enough
code:
-- Default nightly maintenance window task
-- refreshes stats for tables tracked in
-- DBA_TAB_MODIFICATIONS as significantly changed

-- But after a huge one-time load, don't wait:
EXEC DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS('APP', 'ORDERS');
-- ...run it right after the load, before
-- the next query plan gets built on stale stats
caption: Auto stats handle drift. Bulk loads still need a deliberate gather.
